reviewItem.question: For "Shallow evaluation of Variables: Kyverno performs nested variable substitution by default, this may not be desirable in certain situations", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a `{{- ... }}` notation for shallow (one-time) variable substitution, letting a policy substitute rule data (e.g. an HCL string defined in a ConfigMap) without Kyverno attempting to resolve the nested `{{ }}` variables inside it.
